facts.value: Learn about social, economic and political changes, including the role of technology in Arizona State University’s online Master of Science in global technology and development. In this program, you’ll focus more on the impact society has on technology rather than the other way around. Upon graduation, you’ll be equipped for careers in both the public and private sectors that address global disparities such as resource accessibility.
